section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the Omer offering and its waving relate to the heart's desire, through which God's will is drawn down, achieving true completeness.
section.t: And this is what is said, "And you shall count for yourselves... from the day you bring the Omer of the waving..."
For the matter of the Omer of the waving etc. is as stated,
"And he shall wave the Omer... for your acceptance,"
"For your acceptance" is the desire of the heart,
they make and draw down the will of the Omnipresent.
And this is: When are they complete? At the time when Israel does the will of the Omnipresent,
For this drawing down is the matter of completeness,
